quotes.author: Chris Hill
quotes.text: Blake is a stellar boat captain and gives the best experience he can regardless of conditions. We went for my friend’s birthday and still had a fantastic time despite the rain! He’s got good music and a great personality to make any experience a good one! I’ll recommend him to any friends looking for a skilled boat captain and a day to remember!

quotes.author: Jadon Kempers
quotes.text: Wow! I wish I could give more than 5 stars… Lake Life Texas exceeded my expectations and made sure my bachelor party was one to remember. Blake’s customer service was second to none and I will definitely be booking more charters for the future. If you want to be on one of the nicest boats on Lake Austin this is definitely the company for you!

quotes.author: Tommy Jacobson
quotes.text: Blake was awesome! We had a great day wake surfing. We had a few beginners that he was able to get up and surfing in only a few tries and then for some of our more experienced surfers he had the wake chest high for us! Would highly recommend for an easy going, knowledgeable wake surf captain.

quotes.author: Molly Halstenson
quotes.text: We had a great day with Lake Life Texas. Blake was nice to work with and very easy communication/planning. Boat was great and our driver Christian was very kind and professional. Couldn’t have asked for anything better. I highly recommend them for your lake time!!

quotes.author: Hassan Khwaja
quotes.text: Blake and Nadia were amazing!!! Had such a great time with them! Blake showed us the best spots on the Colorado River and was an amazing captain. Thank you so much for such a memorable experience!!!

quotes.author: Alicia Senase
quotes.text: Chris was a great host! Brought lots of life to the bachelorette party, has games for us, and just overall a great captain!
